name: Living Globe Tycoon · Island Steward
description: A walkable local 3D island stewardship game with deterministic ecology, economy, twelve seeded errands and repeatable four-mission tours, plus a separate rules lab for inspecting the underlying model.

play_modes.label: Living Globe Steward
play_modes.description: Steward the visible island globe, observe its living systems, walk the world and open the causal governance brief.

play_modes.label: Rules Lab (advanced)
play_modes.description: Inspect the bounded 8×8 deterministic economy model without mistaking the test harness for the planet game.

game_night.authority_scope: The managed server owns launch/session routing; the experimental game world remains explicitly browser-local inside this package.
game_night.disconnect_recovery_scope: Slot 010 exposes no in-session controller, room, SSE, WebSocket or gameplay API transport to disconnect: the managed server owns launch metadata and static delivery only, while both play modes execute browser-locally. As a countercheck at 1280x720, the loaded walkable world continued through a zero-listener server outage, then a same-port server restart and page reload visibly restored the browser-local world and active mission. External adapter transport, physical-network behavior and cross-browser save roaming remain outside this scope.
game_night.blocking_overlay_escape_scope: 1280x720 desktop browser on the production walkable route: Escape at the entry dialog enters the live browser-local world; Escape closes the Palace and Island Brief dialogs and restores focus; Escape with no blocker is inert. The separate rules-lab route presents no blocking overlay, and focused Escape leaves turn 0 and revision 0 unchanged. Browser-local ecology, timers and observation revisions continue normally while overlays are read.
game_night.physical_phone_qa_scope: The same-screen game advertises touch input, but physical touch feel, handset layout, alternate mobile viewports and device performance remain untested. It has no remote phone-controller or LAN join route; this pending gate concerns the advertised local touch experience only.
